children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 15, 2026) - Global UAV Technologies Ltd. (CSE: UAV.X) (OTC Pink: YRLLF) (FSE: YAB) (the "
Company
") is pleased to announce that further to its news release dated August 24, 2026, the Company has closed a non-brokered private placement (the "
Offering
") consisting of an aggregate of 11,112,500 common shares (each, a "
Share
") at a price of $0.40 per Share for aggregate gross proceeds of $4,445,000.
In connection with the closing, the Company: (i) paid an aggregate cash finders' fees of $38,240.00, and (ii) issued 95,600 broker warrants (each, a "
Broker Warrant
") to certain eligible finders in connection with the Offering. Each Broker Warrant is exercisable into one Share (each, a "
Broker Warrant Share
") at a price of $0.40 per Broker Warrant Share until October 15, 2028, subject to the terms and conditions contained in the warrant certificate (each, a "
Broker Warrant Certificate

The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the Offering for the development and assessment of intellectual property, marketing, investor relations, general and administrative expenses and general corporate purposes.
Closing of the Offering is subject to receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals, including from the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "
CSE
"). All securities issued in relation to the Offering are subject to a hold period expiring four months and one day after the closing date, in accordance with applicable securities laws.
Trading in the Company's securities remains halted in accordance with the policies of the CSE pending completion of the review process in respect of the proposed transaction.
On Behalf of the Board of Directors
"Ron Schmitz"
